entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ahh... This is heaven...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Cats really do like nature, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That has nothing to do with it! It just[n]feels good to be free, since I'm always[n]cooped up in that bag.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, the city stinks. It's been a while[n]since I've smelled anything this fresh.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think I get it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The park has this slightly damp air, right?[n]I feel calm when I smell it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still, the city's all flashy and bustlin' with[n]people. I can't say no to that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You think so? Which do you like,[n][fName]?
The glitz of the city.
The tranquility of nature.
They both have their merits.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, that's right. You've lived in both[n]the city and the suburbs, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wanna go on a trip! Somewhere like[n]the hot springs or the beach.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A trip, huh? I've never left the main[n]island...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Actually, I've prolly never even left[n]the Kanto region.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, our school trip is gonna be overseas.[n]Have you gotten your passport yet?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nope... Fillin' out paperwork at the[n]government office is a pain in the ass.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, what should we do about Morgana?[n]He'll have to stay home at [fName]'s[n]place, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Zzz...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's... basking in the sun...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Haha, typical cat!
I relaxed at the park with everyone...
